timeline.summary: Harsha Viji, promoter group member, confirmed no encumbrance on Sundaram Finance shares for FY2025-26 or earlier.
India Motor Parts & Accessories Limited, promoter of Sundaram Finance Limited, declared no substantial share acquisition in FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) on 2026-04-02.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,560.4 Cr (+13.3% YoY), net profit ₹554.17 Cr (+0.2% YoY).
Board of Directors, led by P.N. Srikant (CCO & Company Secretary), recommended ₹24 per share final dividend (240%) on May 25, 2026, payable after July 23, 2026, for FY2026.
Sundaram Finance announced a board approval to raise up to ₹500 crore in Tier 2 capital through subordinated NCDs in FY2026-27.
At AGM on 22 July 2026, 27.21% of public institutional votes were cast against the re-appointment of director Harsha Viji.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,644.13 Cr (+12.6% YoY), net profit ₹636.19 Cr (+33.9% YoY).
Board re-appointed P. N. Srikant as Chief Compliance Officer & Company Secretary for 5 years w.e.f. August 11, 2026.
Sundaram Finance Q1FY27 results: AUM ₹62,275 Cr (+17% YoY), disbursements ₹8,947 Cr (+22% YoY), PAT ₹522 Cr (+22% YoY)
